pairs.why: B's rim is a deeper red-orange like the real clock, but both backgrounds drift to yellow-lime instead of the real minty emerald green.
A keeps a teal-to-deep-blue background with a dark navy body and small muted lights, closer to the real card's restrained palette than B's louder cyan and glowing lamps.
Both use the same lavender-grey regolith, white dome, blue glass and purple sky, so color gives no reason to choose.
A has the real card's navy keys and body with cyan accents, while B's cream keys add a hue family the real card doesn't have.
Both match the real blue door, orange frame, cream wall and green ivy about equally.
Both have similar pastel pink-blue skies and periwinkle bodies, and neither is closer to the real card's clearer cyan sky.
Both have nearly the same orange-wood and red-brown wall palette with navy and white cap and gold trim.
B's trunk is a clean orange like the real trunk, whereas A's is darker and redder; both backgrounds are more saturated than the real lighter magenta.
